name: Selaphiel
source:
Selaphiel is an angel nicknamed Angel of Violence, and believes the holiest emotion given by God is violence.

Since God disappeared, he has been growing in power as he gains followers with the goal of creating a Heaven centered around himself. He is a fallen angel who is true to his desires and thinks that he can even have devils as his subordinates if only it fits his purpose.
